# hrm-ired

Vendored implementation, installable with `python -m pip install -e . -e third_party/ired` from the HRM repository root.

Base repository: https://github.com/yilundu/ired_code_release.git

Base commit: `3d74b85fab7fcf5e28aaf15e9ed3bf51c1a1d545`.

See `SOURCE.json` for the supplied code hashes and namespace-only source adaptations.

For portable Extreme-1k preparation, training and final-EMA evaluation, see [Extreme-1k commands](../../exp/sudoku/README.md). For public SAT-Net/RRN preparation, training and controlled diagnostics, see [SAT-Net/RRN commands](../../exp/sudoku/README.md). Supply checkpoints and records for the selected comparison.
